text: The team reviewed the working design and will continue review before the next meeting. Marketing Expert is tasked with producing mock-ups and general ideas. Unclear technical platform decisions were identified, including which machines run the functions, the interface type (text screen or Bluetooth), and whether the system should be one-way or multi-purpose. The selling price of the remote was set at 25 Euro. The remote should remain basic and focused on channel switching, avoiding multi-function features. Consensus on project scope and what we are going to make is deferred to the next meeting. There is consensus on the plan and ensuring that user requirements align with the technical functions.
